notes: Portable public-API translation of the verified 15-assertion native constrained-TAR Time Constrained disable witness. The adapter supplies a complete FOM with the standard nonRegulatedGrant switch disabled, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback model. One constrained federate requests a strict TAR with no regulator and observes no grant; disabling Time Constrained releases exactly one grant at the requested time. The public switch getter confirms the FOM precondition. Direct native traceability pairs are page-191-l73-17 to IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause 8.5.5, page-192-l63-17 to clause 8.6.3, page-193-l58-12 to clause 8.7.5, and page-194-l21-3 and page-194-l69-19 to clause 8.8.3. Official-header C++ primary and contract passed twice in evoked and immediate models against installed package libraries. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime result. No provider-independent conformance claim is made.
